brief: @buildthis.bisks.net could you please make an advent calendar? have it save state in localstorage so that people can open one door per day, and the gifts inside are little pieces of glitch art or highly-liked photos from one's moots or something else cool
note: built mootvent: 24 doors, one unlocks per day, each holding a glitched highly-liked photo from your moots (or procedural glitch art once those run out) — all saved in localStorage.
